LOOK OUT—today’s sky opens a generous window.  
The Sun sextile Jupiter signals a gentle lift in optimism and opportunity. Symbolically, the Sun’s brightness meets Jupiter’s expansive spirit, inviting you to broaden horizons, share enthusiasm, and celebrate progress. In the collective, this is a moment to extend kindness, pursue growth, and trust that good fortune is already on its way.  
Take a moment to share a genuine compliment with someone you admire.
